title: Standardize semantic ramp and compact shadow language for data widgets
creator: Maya Chen
description: Audit and consolidate the current token set used by data-dense widgets (tables, charts, heatmaps) to a small, semantically named color/typography/spacing ramp plus a compact shadow vocabulary. Goal: reduce token surface area for high-density surfaces, improve cross-team consistency, and make migration predictable for engineering. Deliverables: canonical token map, annotated component token substitutions, Sketch/Figma token file, accessibility contrast report, migration guide, and a lightweight rollout plan for Console and components library.
background: Multiple product teams have created ad-hoc color ramps and shadow presets for density-optimized components. This has introduced token sprawl, confusing aliasing (e.g., surface-1a vs surface-100), and inconsistent elevation behavior in tight UIs. Recent performance work also shows that a smaller set of canonical tokens simplifies runtime theming and reduces bundle size for our CSS-in-JS exports.
decision_summary: We will introduce a compact semantic ramp (neutral-2 -> neutral-6) and three accent ramps (accent-weak, accent-default, accent-strong) with explicit overlays for selected states. Elevation will be reduced to three compact presets (flat, lift-1, lift-2) expressed as combined shadow + subtle outline for high-contrast modes. Tokens will be semantic (e.g., token.surface.data-1) rather than numeric-only. Breaking changes will be mitigated via automated alias maps and a staged Console rollout.
acceptance_criteria: Canonical token list published in Figma and tokens repo with names and hex/rgba values
Component-level mapping table that shows previous tokens -> new semantic tokens for tables, charts, and button variants
Contrast audit showing all token pairs meet WCAG AA (where required) and documented exceptions with rationale
Design review sign-off from Product and Accessibility lead
Migration guide and one automated codemod that converts token imports in components repo
A Console canary demonstrating tokens applied to a dense dashboard with no layout regressions
